description: Incremental sync of events in the signed-in user's mailbox, not a calendarView. startDateTime sets the earliest event start to include. Each event has only id, type, start and end; use get-calendar-event for the rest. For a time-bounded view with expanded recurring instances, use list-calendar-view-delta instead.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure indication

fetchAllPages.description: Follow @odata.nextLink and merge up to 100 pages into one response. Can return enormous payloads—only when the user explicitly needs a full export.

includeHeaders.description: Include response headers (including ETag) in the response metadata

skiptoken.description: Next page: the @odata.nextLink from the previous response. Keep the other arguments the same.

startDateTime.description: The start date and time of the time range in the function, represented in ISO 8601 format. For example, 2019-11-08T20:00:00-08:00

name: list-calendar-events-delta
